title: A Horizon for the Colony
author: Ivo Nakamura
blurb: Dominic Quintana, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
